Caller logs trace the failures one hop down: ts-inside-payment-service -> 'HttpServerErrorException: 500 ... path:/api/v1/paymentservice/payment' (65x) and ts-preserve-service -> '500 ... path:/api/v1/orderservice/order' (9x). The downstream writer services themselves carry the decisive mechanism: ts-payment-service and ts-order-service both log 'SQL Error: 1290, SQLState: HY000' + 'The MySQL server is running with the --read-only option so it cannot execute this statement' (65x / 52x) followed by JpaSystemException: could not execute statement -> HTTP 500. Two independent writers rejected by the same shared DB point the break at the database layer. Configuration confirms the target: ts-payment-service's secret sets PAYMENT_MYSQL_HOST=tsdb-mysql-leader:3306, and the tsdb-mysql StatefulSet (radondb/percona:5.7.34 with Xenon HA) has tsdb-mysql-0 labeled role=leader (the instance behind tsdb-mysql-leader, with followers replicating from tsdb-mysql-0). CheckServiceConnectivity(tsdb-mysql-leader:3306) succeeded from worker-01/02/03, so DNS/port/credentials are fine - the server is up but rejects write statements, i.e. it is running in read-only mode. Object layer shows all pods 1/1 Running with no FailedScheduling/FailedCreate/FailedMount/image-pull events, and namespace events contain only probe/BackOff warnings during startup, excluding scheduling, admission, mount and image faults.
